title: Extrinsic geometry and Hamiltonian analysis of symmetric teleparallel gravity
summary: We analyze the properties of foliations in presence of non-metricity, deriving the generalized Gauss-Codazzi relations in full generality. These results are employed to study the teleparallel framework of non-metric geometry, obtaining constraints on the extrinsic and intrinsic tensors. In particular, an extrinsic symmetric two-tensor plays the role of the extrinsic curvature in Riemannian geometry, whereas no other geometric object can induce new dynamical degrees of freedom.
